title: Aim2Balance
tagline: EU-hosted AI chat platform with EUR billing and cross-provider token tracking
description: Co-founded and built an AI chat platform forked from LibreChat, hosted in the EU for GDPR compliance. Engineered EUR-based billing with Stripe wallets processing 10,000+ daily sessions, a Chrome extension tracking token consumption across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, and cross-platform mobile apps via Capacitor.
pullQuote: We forked an open-source chat platform into an EU-hosted product handling 10,000 sessions a day.

title: Roofcast
tagline: Decentralized prediction market for real estate on Polygon
description: A Web3 DApp built on Polygon using Gnosis Conditional Tokens for real estate prediction markets. Users stake on property value outcomes with fully on-chain settlement. Integrated WalletConnect, token creation, and real-time market data feeds.
pullQuote: On-chain prediction markets where real money settles on real estate outcomes.

title: Jeofferte
tagline: Dutch quote marketplace connecting customers with expert service providers
description: A Dutch-language platform connecting customers with expert service providers. Customers request quotes without logging in, while registered suppliers purchase and respond to requests directly. Features Stripe payments, WhatsApp and email notifications, and a custom background system that pre-processes matches based on location and expertise for instant results.
pullQuote: Customers post a request. Suppliers see it instantly. No login, no friction, no delay.

title: Meshi
tagline: Geo-based food platform connecting users with nearby providers in real time
description: A food-tech platform with a geo-based matching engine that connects users to nearby food providers. Built location-aware search with PostGIS, real-time availability tracking, and a streamlined ordering flow. Modernized the entire UI from legacy code to a React component system.
pullQuote: Matching hungry users with the closest kitchen — in under two seconds.

title: Intex Exchange
tagline: Real-time cryptocurrency trading platform with PWA and TradingView integration
description: A cryptocurrency exchange with real-time trading interfaces, TradingView charts, and WebSocket price feeds. Improved load times from 4.2s to 2.9s through bottleneck optimization. Introduced PWA with hybrid caching — cache-first for static assets, network-first for APIs. Built a shared component library that cut feature delivery from 8 to 5 days and mentored two junior developers.
pullQuote: Load time down from 4.2 to 2.9 seconds. Component library cut feature delivery from 8 days to 5.

title: DApp Solutions
tagline: Blockchain-based real estate platform for buying and renting property with crypto
description: A decentralized platform enabling users to buy or rent property using cryptocurrency. Smart contracts handle the full transaction lifecycle — funds are securely locked and released only after document verification. Features WalletConnect authentication, on-chain signing, and a responsive SEO-optimized frontend.
pullQuote: Smart contracts lock the funds. Documents get verified. Only then does the money move.

title: Panikar Assessment
tagline: Personality assessment platform serving 5,000+ users for career guidance
description: A personality assessment tool for career guidance that scaled to 5,000+ active users. Built the interactive test interface, results visualization, and admin dashboard. Optimized Webpack bundles reducing load times by 10–15% and built an internal design system adopted across the team.
pullQuote: Five thousand people used this tool to figure out what they're good at. The code had to be as reliable as the psychology.

title: 3gaam
tagline: AI-driven student resource platform with interactive learning tools
description: An AI-driven student resource platform with interactive learning interfaces and GraphQL-powered content delivery. Fixed critical API performance issues and led the company's first production TypeScript migration.
pullQuote: The platform where students found answers — and where I learned to ship TypeScript to production.
